UGA.note: The statement that AI is not covered by existing law concerns tax exemptions, not AI harms.
The URA use is in tax administration, which this study excludes.

facts.fact: Uganda Revenue Authority Commissioner General John Rujoki Musinguzi said URA used AI to identify tax evasion such as undeclared imports and false VAT claims.
Musinguzi said URA recovered 200 billion shillings in revenue leakages uncovered through the use of AI in the previous year.
